prompt: I need help for organize my directories, I code in bash in python , machine learning ,but in the end i finish with a lot of files in python , How can I organize this trees.
response: Organizing your directories is essential for maintaining an efficient workflow. You can create a main directory for each project, and within it, have subdirectories for Python scripts, data, and results. Use descriptive naming conventions for your files and scripts to easily identify their purpose. Regularly review and clean up your directory structure to remove obsolete files. This approach keeps your project organized and accessible.
